summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K reporting entry into a second forbearance agreement with SemiCab, Inc. regarding a $1.75M promissory note issued May 2, 2025. The note required a $1.5M initial payment by May 2, 2026, which the issuer failed to make. The seller waived defaults and agreed to forbear from enforcement until July 16, 2026. No special-situation catalyst (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change) is present. This is a routine debt forbearance, not a special situation.
